title: Private Halifax Walking Tour: Historic Downtown & Waterfront
blurb:
PLEASE BOOK THE FIRST TOUR AT 9:30 AM. IF YOU SELECT ANOTHER TIME, YOU MAY BE MOVED TO THE 9:30 AM TOUR FIRST, AS TOUR SLOTS ARE FILLED ACCORDING TO THE EARLIEST STARTING TIME BEFORE LATER TIMES.

Join me for a walking tour through the Halifax I know and love. As the city lights come on and the waterfront comes alive, we'll explore the historic streets of Downtown Halifax, uncover hidden corners, and hear the stories that shaped this remarkable port city. From famous landmarks and maritime history to local legends and unexpected moments, you'll see Halifax from a local's perspective—not just as a visitor. Along the way, I'll share my favorite photo spots, recommend the best places to eat, drink, and explore, and help you experience the city's welcoming East Coast charm. Whether it's your first time in Halifax or you're returning for another visit, this relaxed walking tour is a memorable way to discover the city.
